notes: Hanfield Street: name is printed only west of the strip ('...FIELD') and 'STREET' east of Witler; the plate is cut along its north side, so its centre is taken midway between the cut edge and the south lot line (about 185 px, 60 ft); a solid line and a dashed sewer run inside it. The '?' street is a short unnamed stub leaving Hanfield northward at x about 6705-6825 (carries a 12 in. sewer); nothing continues south of Hanfield there. Gordon Street continues north of Hanfield as a similar stub. Blue Rock Street meets Colerain Avenue at Colerain's angle point (three-way). Powers Street name is not printed inside the strip; only its north side is on the plate at the bottom edge, centre assumed 25 ft south of the lot line; whether Borden continues south of Powers is off the plate. Hoffner Avenue: only 'AVE.' printed in the strip; edges taken as y about 5255 and 5405, the line at y 5315 is the 6 in. water pipe. Wesleyan Cemetery fills the middle of the strip (no streets). Colerain Avenue leaves the picking zone (x 7520) at about y 4357.
